# Write test_m2.py - fixed
test_m2 = '''"""Tests for milestone m2: dots replaced with underscores in completion env var name."""

def test_dots_replaced_in_env_var():
    """prog_name='my.app' produces _MY_APP_COMPLETE (no dots) in generated script."""
    from click.shell_completion import add_completion_class, ShellComplete
    from click.core import Command

    @add_completion_class("bash")
    class MyBashCompletion:
        name = "bash"

    cli = Command("myapp")
    complete_var = MyBashCompletion(cli, {}, "my.app", "").get_completion_var()

    assert "." not in complete_var, (
        "complete_var %r still contains dots; expected no dots" % complete_var
    )
    assert complete_var == "_MY_APP_COMPLETE", (
        "Expected _MY_APP_COMPLETE, got %r" % complete_var
    )


def test_prog_name_without_unchanged():
    """prog_name='myapp' still produces _MYAPP_COMPLETE unchanged."""
    from click.shell_completion import add_completion_class, ShellComplete
    from click.core import Command

    @add_completion_class("bash")
    class MyBashCompletion:
        name = "bash"

    cli = Command("myapp")
    complete_var = MyBashCompletion(cli, {}, "myapp", "").get_completion_var()

    assert complete_var == "_MYAPP_COMPLETE", (
        "Expected _MYAPP_COMPLETE, got %r" % complete_var
    )


def test_source_contains_normalized_var():
    """Generated bash source for prog_name='my.app' contains _MY_APP_COMPLETE."""
    from click.shell_completion import add_completion_class, ShellComplete
    from click.core import Command

    @add_completion_class("bash")
    class MyBashCompletion:
        name = "bash"

    cli = Command("myapp")
    comp = MyBashCompletion(cli, {}, "my.app", "")
    complete_var = comp.get_completion_var()
    source = comp.source()

    assert "_MY_APP_COMPLETE" in source, (
        "Source does not contain _MY_APP_COMPLETE:\\n%s" % source[:500]
    )
    assert "_MY.APP_COMPLETE" not in source, (
        "Source still contains dot in var name:\\n%s" % source[:500]
    )
'''

with open('crucible_hidden/test_m2.py', 'w') as f:
    f.write(test_m2)

print("test_m2.py written successfully")
